verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents broad programmatic coverage: a CKS API to create, list, update and delete clusters, a Terraform provider spanning CKS, VPC, object storage and Managed Inference, an Inference API, and a FOCUS API (Public Preview) for usage export. However, no doc claims full API/UI parity, and some workflows, such as Capacity Finder and quota viewing or increase requests, are documented only in the Cloud Console. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, documented API equivalents for Capacity Finder and quota management, GA status for billing export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API lets you create, list, update, and delete managed Kubernetes clusters on CoreWeave infrastructure.
The CoreWeave Terraform provider lets you manage CoreWeave infrastructure as code, including CKS clusters, VPC networking, AI Object Storage policies and buckets, and Managed Inference resources.
The CoreWeave Inference API provides programmatic control over inference gateways, model deployments, and capacity claims.
You can also export usage programmatically with the FOCUS API (Public Preview)
